title: East Nashville Private Suite near Downtown
description:
Fully equipped guest suite in a quaint neighborhood of East Nashville, minutes away from Downtown Broadway and the Titian's Stadium. This modern space provides all the comforts of home with a full kitchen, large bathroom, private bedroom, and additional queen pullout bed.  

After a busy day of sightseeing relax at this charming space or take a pleasant walk in the expansive nature preserve bordering the neighborhood.
